title: Capital Flows and the FX Market
overview: Capital flows and foreign-exchange markets connect cross-border investment with currency supply and demand.
example: Trace a policy or market shock through incentives, quantities, prices, growth, and currency effects.

modules.title: The Foreign Exchange Market
modules.explanation: An exchange rate is the price of one currency in another, so quotation direction matters. Spot, forward, and cross rates must use consistent base currencies; forward premiums or discounts reflect relative financing conditions under covered interest parity.
steps: Write the currency pair and label base and price currency.
Invert or chain quotes only after aligning units.
Check that appreciation, depreciation, and forward points move in the economically correct direction.
